title: PULSE timing requirement
description: One timing requirement bound to one pulse-core task. Verdicts are computed per requirement per run (see verdict_rules.md).

at_risk_margin_pct.description: at_risk when latency_us.max is within this percentage of max_latency_us (inclusive).

owner.description: Atlassian account id of the owner. null when not yet assigned (for example demo data loaded on a site where the owner does not exist).

owner_name.description: Optional display name. Used when owner is null or cannot be resolved on this site.

jira_issue.description: Jira work item key that holds this requirement, e.g. PULSE-12. null when not linked yet.

source_note.description: Optional path or URL to the research note that justifies the limit, e.g. research/brake.md.
